app.name: Kasuwa

tokens.page.title: Alamomin ƙira
tokens.page.subtitle: Kasuwa Design {version} — tushen gaskiya guda ɗaya na launi, rubutu, sarari da motsi.
tokens.provisional.notice: Na ɗan lokaci. An samo waɗannan ma'aunai daga ginshiƙan alama guda uku na Prompt 0, kuma za a maye gurbinsu da fitarwar Claude Design. Duba shawarar D-L10.
tokens.contrast.label: {ratio} zuwa 1 a kan {background}
notFound.title: Ba a sami shafin ba
notFound.body: Shafin da ka nema babu shi, ko kuma ba ka da izinin ganinsa.
tokens.approved.notice: An shigo da shi daga fitarwar Claude Design da aka amince da ita. Na'ura ce ke cire ƙimar launi; gyara su da hannu zai koma baya a shigowa ta gaba.
auth.panel.headline: Duk hirar abokan ciniki. Wuri ɗaya.
auth.panel.body: WhatsApp, kira, SMS da imel don ƙungiyoyin tallace-tallace da tallafi a Legas, Accra, Nairobi, Johannesburg da Dakar.
auth.panel.trust.encryption: Ɓoye bayanai irin na banki, a hanya da kuma a ajiye
auth.panel.trust.compliance: An gina shi don NDPA (Najeriya) da POPIA (Afirka ta Kudu)
auth.signIn.title: Barka da dawowa
auth.signIn.subtitle: Shiga wurin aikinku na Kasuwa.
auth.signIn.divider: ko yi amfani da imel ɗinku
auth.signIn.workspace.label: Wurin aiki
auth.signIn.workspace.help: Gajeren sunan wurin aikinku, kamar sahel-bpo.
auth.signIn.email.label: Imel na aiki
auth.signIn.password.label: Kalmar sirri
auth.signIn.remember: Ka bar ni a shige a wannan na'urar
auth.locked.title: An kulle asusunku na minti 15
auth.locked.body: An yi kalmomin sirri marasa daidai da yawa don {emailHint}. Muna kulle asusun don kare bayanan abokan cinikinku.
auth.locked.retryAt: Za ku iya sake gwadawa da ƙarfe {time} ({zone})
auth.locked.resetEmail: Sake saita kalmar sirri ta imel
auth.locked.resetSms: Samu lambar sake saitawa ta SMS
auth.locked.notYou: Ba kai ba ne? Mai gudanarwa yana iya ganin inda gwaje-gwajen suka fito.
auth.sso.title: Shiga da SSO
auth.sso.subtitle: Rubuta yankin imel na kamfaninku. Za mu kai ku shafin shiga na kamfaninku.
auth.sso.domain.label: Yankin aiki
auth.sso.providers: Yana aiki da Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta da duk wani mai bayar da SAML 2.0.
auth.slow.title: Har yanzu ana haɗawa…
auth.slow.body: Hanyar sadarwarku a hankali take. Yanayin ƙarancin bayanai yana loda shafi mai sauƙi ba tare da hotuna ba.
auth.lite.on: An kunna yanayin ƙarancin bayanai. Kuna iya kashe shi a kowane lokaci daga sandar sama.
auth.lite.deferred: Google, Microsoft, SSO da maɓallan shiga suna lodawa idan kun taɓa su.
auth.mfa.title.sms: Shigar da lambar da muka aika
auth.mfa.body.app: Shigar da lamba mai lambobi 6 daga Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator ko makamanciyar manhaja.
auth.mfa.body.sms: An aika lamba zuwa {hint} ta SMS. Tana aiki na minti 10.
auth.mfa.code.label: Lamba mai lambobi 6
auth.mfa.trustDevice: Amince da wannan na'urar na kwanaki 30
auth.mfa.sms.slow: SMS na iya ɗaukar har minti 2 a hanyoyin sadarwa masu cunkoso. Har yanzu babu komai?
auth.attemptsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# gwaji ya rage kafin mu kulle asusun na minti 15.} other {# gwaje-gwaje suka rage kafin mu kulle asusun na minti 15.}}
auth.error.validation_failed: Wasu abubuwan da kuka rubuta ba daidai ba ne tukuna. Duba filayen da aka yi wa alama a ƙasa.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: Wannan imel da kalmar sirri ba su yi daidai ba. Duba kurakuran rubutu da maɓallin manyan haruffa.
auth.error.mfa_code_invalid: Wannan lambar ba ta yi daidai ba. Duba manhajar tantancewarku sannan ku sake gwadawa.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_expired: Wannan lambar ta ƙare. Lambobi suna aiki na minti 10. Ku nemi sabuwa a ƙasa — tsohuwar ba za ta ƙara aiki ba.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_invalid: Ku sake shiga don ci gaba.
auth.error.resend_too_soon: Ku jira kaɗan kafin ku nemi wata lambar.
auth.error.sso_domain_not_found: Ba mu sami SSO don {domain} ba. Duba rubutun, ko ku tambayi ƙungiyar IT ɗinku ko an saita SSO don Kasuwa.
auth.error.otp_invalid: Wannan lambar ba ta yi daidai ba. Duba ta sannan ku sake gwadawa.
auth.error.otp_expired: Wannan lambar ta ƙare. Lambobi suna aiki na minti goma.
auth.error.otp_too_many_attempts: Gwaje-gwaje sun yi yawa. Ku nemi sabuwar lamba.
auth.error.not_authenticated: Ku sake shiga don ci gaba.
auth.error.not_implemented: Wannan ɓangaren Kasuwa bai shirya ba tukuna.
auth.error.network: Ba mu iya isa ga Kasuwa ba. Duba haɗin ku sannan ku sake gwadawa.
